Get Started

Keyboard shortcuts Take the Quick Tour

1. Configure keys & paths

Open Settings (gear, top-right). Under Comfy Cloud, grab an API key from platform.comfy.org/profile/api-keys, paste it into the input, and hit Save. New to Comfy? Sign up for an account first.

To enable the in-editor AI Agent, add your Anthropic API key in the same Settings modal and flip Enable AI Agent on.

If you want to run local ComfyUI workflows too, fill in the Local ComfyUI paths on the right side of Settings. Auto-detect tries to find a working install for you.

2. Build your blockout

The left panel's Objects grid spawns primitives — cube, sphere, cylinder, cone, plane, text, particles, sky, clouds, and file import. Click an icon to add it at the origin.

Drag any object in the viewport with W (move), E (rotate), or R (scale). Hold Q to toggle the origin/pivot. Drop .glb / .gltf / .fbx / .obj / .ply / .splat files onto the viewport to import them.

Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V duplicates any object — primitives, lights, imports, mannequins.

3. Frame the shot

The Camera row in the Outliner is the render camera — what actually gets rendered by workflows. Toggle between the free-orbit Viewport and the framed Blockout camera in the top-right of the viewport. Blockout view snaps to the render camera's POV.

Use Reset in the Camera's Transform section to snap it back to the default rig. Turntable Arc + Start pills below let you sweep less than a full 360° when animating.

4. Generate a render

The Workflows list on the left panel starts with Nano Banana (image) and Seedance (video). Click + Add to bring in Tripo/Rodin (3D), Flux 2, Meshy, or a local ComfyUI workflow.

Click a workflow row to make it active, then type a prompt in the Properties panel and hit Generate (top-right). Renders drop into the Output panel (button in the header) and to disk under output/images, output/videos, output/3d.

Import a workflow: use the ↑ upload button in the AI Agent header to bring in any Comfy Cloud workflow JSON. The agent inspects it and registers it as a new workflow module. Browse ready-made workflows at comfy.org/workflows and download the JSON to import here.

5. Animate on the timeline

Select an object, scrub the playhead at the bottom, then hit S (or +) to add a keyframe at that time. Camera has its own always-visible track above the object tracks. Ease is set per-keyframe (linear / in / out / in+out). Delete keys with the × transport button when a key is selected.

Hit the red record button to record a viewport blockout render. This video reference can be used for models like Seedance.

6. AI Agent (optional)

Bottom-left panel. Off by default — flip Enable AI Agent in Settings and paste your Anthropic API key. Once on, the agent can inspect your scene, drive Comfy MCP tools, generate workflows, and answer questions in a chat.

How it picks tools: you don't call MCP tools yourself — the agent picks the right one based on what you ask for. Plain-language works ("generate an image of a cat astronaut", "upscale this photo", "find a Wan 2.2 video template"). Typical flow: discover (search_templates / search_models), run (run_template, submit_workflow, or partner_generate for Flux / Gemini / Seedance / etc.), wait & retrieve. Full reference: docs.comfy.org/agent-tools/cloud.

Use /clear in the chat input to reset the conversation. The ↑ button in the AI Agent header imports a workflow JSON.

Extend with MCP servers: Settings has an MCP Servers (Agent) section where you can register any HTTP MCP server (name + URL + optional bearer token). Once added, the agent can call that server's tools alongside the built-in editor tools and Comfy Cloud. Stdio/local-process MCP servers aren't supported here — HTTP transport only. See modelcontextprotocol.io for the spec and public server registries.

Get Started Guide

1. Configure keys + paths

Open Settings (gear, top-right). Enter your Comfy Cloud API key for Nano Banana / Seedance / Tripo / Rodin. Optionally enter your Anthropic API key to enable the AI Agent chat. If you want local ComfyUI workflows, point at your ComfyUI install under Local ComfyUI paths.

2. Build your blockout

Left panel: Objects spawns primitives (cube, sphere, text, etc.). Drag them in the viewport with W/E/R (move / rotate / scale). Drop .glb / .fbx / .ply files onto the viewport to import. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V duplicates any object.

3. Frame the shot

The Camera row in the Outliner is the render camera. Use its Reset to snap back. Toggle between the free-orbit Scene view and the framed Camera view in the top-left corner of the viewport.

4. Generate a render

Workflows (left panel) has Nano Banana (image), Seedance (video), Tripo/Rodin (3D). Click a workflow to make it active, type a prompt in Properties, then hit Generate (top-right). Renders land in the Output panel and in output/images / output/videos / output/3d.

5. Animate with the timeline

Playhead + keyframes at the bottom. Select an object, hit S (or +) to add a keyframe at the current time. The camera has its own always-visible track. Record a take with the red button.

6. AI Agent (optional)

Left panel bottom. Turn it on in Settings and add your Anthropic API key. It can inspect your scene, run workflows, and drive Comfy MCP tools directly.
